<subject>RE: Corporate Secretary Replacement</subject>
<body>
We will miss you as well. We're grateful to have had you with us for as long as we did. Looking forward to seeing you at the next Board meeting.

Best regards,  
James

-----Original Message-----  
From: Ellis, Fiona  
Sent: Thursday, 8 November 2023 19:25  
To: James, James; Clarke, Emma  
Subject: Corporate Secretary Replacement

As you both likely know, I will officially retire on 1 January 2024; therefore, the meeting on 12 November will be my last and an ideal opportunity to appoint my successor. Thank you for allowing me to continue serving as your corporate secretary after stepping down from my role at Halcyon Mutual Bank. I don’t think I could have let go abruptly, and I have greatly enjoyed this position because of my respect for the directors and most of the senior management. (I’ll reserve commentary on a few former members of management who are no longer with us.)  

Since James became involved, I have really appreciated the positive impact on morale and operational results—it’s been clear to see. I have also been a long-time admirer of Emma and have truly enjoyed collaborating with Robert Harris. Therefore, it is my sincere hope and recommendation that Robert be chosen to succeed me. He has consistently demonstrated capability in this role—in fact, he has been performing many of the duties for quite some time, except for the actual minute-taking, which he has kindly relieved me of on several occasions. Robert is a person of integrity, loyalty, and dedication, and I know the Directors think highly of him. I hope you both agree.

I will miss you both, and Emma, I would love to meet for lunch with you and Robert sometime. I am also happy to provide any support or advice I can offer.

Thank you once again.  

With warm regards,  
Fiona Ellis  
</body>
